uncertainties: Which of blk+0A44h and blk+0A64h holds which zone set is unread: 009DC2E0's body was not projected and nothing read so far writes either searcher.

0070D400 and 0070D5D0 read one float column of the controller's slots chosen by [ctl+500h]. Which of the two extents is port and which is starboard is not established; only that the pair is swapped into the query when the latch is astern.
[[unit+538h]+500h] is called a class reference speed from its use as a divisor of the body-axis speed. Its producer was not read.
The 009DEEEE comparison can be true on every tick, because nothing in this body stores the re-read key back into blk+30Ch. Whether that is intentional or a bug is not settled here.

The reconstruction is build-tested only: not fixture-tested, not ABI-compatible, not game-validated. The x87 intermediates are modelled as double, which matches the 53-bit MSVC control word but not the 15-bit x87 exponent range.
